name: Rasterization-based Isosurface Extraction (Alpha-Test/Stencil)
aliases: Rasterization-based Isosurface with Alpha-Test and Stencil
definition: An early technique using rasterization hardware with alpha-test and stencil buffer to compute plane-tetrahedra intersections without programmable shaders.
summary: Rasterization-based Isosurface Extraction uses alpha-testing and stencil buffers to identify isosurfaces on legacy hardware without programmable shaders.
